Extract variants based on functional mutation impact (local)

Source: R/sqlite_variant_discovery.R
query_by_impact.Rd

Queries the database to extract variants filtered by their functional impact severity classification (HIGH, MODERATE, LOW, or MODIFIER) following snpEff conventions. Optional chromosome and coordinate range windows can be added to narrow down targets.

Usage

query_by_impact(
  con,
  impact_level = c("HIGH", "MODERATE", "LOW", "MODIFIER"),
  chrom = NULL,
  start = NULL,
  end = NULL
)

Arguments

con

A DBI connection object to the local database generated by connect_local_db().

impact_level

A character vector specifying the variant impact types to retain. Allowed classifications are "HIGH", "MODERATE", "LOW", and "MODIFIER".

chrom

A character value specifying the chromosome name (e.g., "Chr05").

start

Integer. Optional start coordinate for the genomic region.

end

Integer. Optional end coordinate for the genomic region.

Value

A data frame of variants showing their predicted functional impact details and positional coordinates.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Load the package
library(panGenomeBreedr)

# Connect to the database
con <- connect_local_db(folder_path = "~/Desktop/curated_sorghum_variant_resource")

# Extract high-impact variant lines inside a targeted coordinates locus window
high_impact_vars <- query_by_impact(con = con,
                                    impact_level = "HIGH",
                                    chrom = "Chr05",
                                    start = 75104537,
                                    end = 75106403)

# Safely close out resources
disconnect_local_db(con)
} # }
